revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the risk reviewer framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. At the latest operating review, the business owner rejected treating this as a cosmetic rerun. The plan has to follow the commercial interpretation below, with the data-pack labels read literally. Red Star's container run now has to comply with the electricity directive. Each container type may be made under Regular or Eco operation. Eco production uses the `eco_capacity_share` of normal capacity and carries `eco_overhead_cost`, while energy use differs by `regular_energy_intensity_kwh_per_unit` and `eco_energy_intensity_kwh_per_unit`. The whole period must remain within `max_total_energy_kwh` while covering demand with eligible container sizes. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
